reports.method: Real generated JS factories and WASM through unchanged Ymf288/OpnVariant and actual YMF288Synth/OPNDirectTransport. Exact Float32 stereo PCM, bus reads/status/IRQ after each fixture event (register-pair events or individual bus-byte events) and render chunk, partition invariance, selected reset/reprogram replay and post-scenario probes. Independent YMF288 3/6-channel enable, SSG mono mix/tone/noise/envelopes, readable mode/ID/CSM mask, removed prescaler, timers/IRQ masks, reconstructing reset and owned-buffer controls. No tolerance or mock.
limits: sampleRate(clock) calculates floor(clock/16) at the core default MAX fidelity; it does not set a chip clock or output rate. Pitch clocks only quantize authored frequency registers. The FM prescale is fixed at6 and FM output is held for9 generated frames; no dynamic fidelity/prescale API or resampler change is claimed.

The actual 11-function C ABI and OpnVariant have no save/load/state facade, native mute, borrowed-view/Into generation, memory/ROM load or low-level observers. Synth getState is a JS register model, not a restorable native snapshot.

Status/read/IRQ observations are after every fixture bus event and rendered chunk plus continuation probes, not per-master-clock hardware traces. Busy signal stays false in the current shared interface; hardware busy timing is not tested.

OPN_HAS_SSG reset destroys and reconstructs Handle in place, clearing core/SSG resampler/adapter history with a stable JS handle. Cold-versus-reset equality controls apply specifically to this wrapper, unlike the other shared OPN variants.

YMF288 has no DAC, ADPCM-B, IO ports or CSM; the CSM bit is masked. The rhythm engine has configured embedded-ROM addresses but this binding provides no ROM-loading API and inherits zero external reads. Bounded rhythm-control/decode comparisons are not authentic physical rhythm sounds.
Lowlevel reset enables only3FM channels. YMF288Synth.reset writes29=83 to enable6FM channels. The actual direct Synth is FM only; SSG/rhythm are lowlevel register cases, not added Synth preset APIs.

Only synchronous Node/WASM and the actual direct Synth consumer are exercised here. Browser, Worklet scheduling, general Mixer/Playground, Native/Tauri, physical output and listening judgments are outside this checker.
reports.frameCountScope: Both builds: scenario bodies and 127-frame continuation probes, selected reset/reprogram replays, bounded wrapper controls and real Synth output. A stereo frame is one left/right pair; no source or delivered frames are double-counted.
